<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Sistem Informasi Monitoring & Tindak Lanjut Satker - Diktisaintek</title>
  
  <!-- Core Libraries CDN -->
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/react@18/umd/react.production.min.js" crossorigin></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18/umd/react-dom.production.min.js" crossorigin></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone/babel.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');
    body {
      font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif;
      background-color: #f4f7fb;
      color: #0f172a;
    }
    .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
    }
    .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: #cbd5e1;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    /* Institutional visual refinements */
    h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
    button, input, select, textarea { font-family: inherit; }
    table th { letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

    /* Identitas visual institusional */
    .brand-logo { object-fit: contain; }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .brand-logo { max-width: 44vw; }
    }

    /* Professional institutional UI */
    header { backdrop-filter: saturate(120%) blur(6px); }
    .institutional-divider { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(15, 23, 42, .14), transparent); }
    button { letter-spacing: .005em; }
    input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus {
      border-color: #2563eb !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, .10);
    }

    /* Typography hierarchy */
    body {
      font-family: 'Source Sans 3', Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }
    h1 { font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 800; }
    h2 { font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 800; }
    h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 750; }
    h4 { font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 700; }
    h5 { font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 700; }
    p, td, th, label, input, select, textarea, button { line-height: 1.45; }

    /* Clean institutional header/footer */
    .institutional-header-logo {
      display: block;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: left center;
      mix-blend-mode: multiply;
      filter: contrast(1.04) saturate(1.02);
    }
    .institutional-footer {
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);
    }

    /* Final UI/UX polish */
    body { -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
    .ui-section-title { letter-spacing: -.015em; }
    table tbody tr { transition: background-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; }
    table tbody tr:hover { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #2563eb; }
    input, select, textarea {
      transition: border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, background-color .15s ease;
    }
    button { transition: transform .12s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; }
    button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
    .institutional-footer p { margin: 0; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="root"></div>

  <script type="text/babel">
    const { useState, useEffect, useMemo } = React;

    // --- DATA KREDENSIAL PRIVAT & PERMASALAHAN INITIAL SATKER ---
    const DATABASE_SATKER_INITIAL = [
      {
        id: "satker-101",
        nama: "Politeknik Maritim Negeri Indonesia",
        kode: "693491",
        singkatan: "Polimarin",
        email: "admin@polimarin.ac.id",
        sandi: "Polimarin2026!",
        issues: [
          {
            id: "iss-101",
            judul: "Keterlambatan Sertifikasi Alat Simulator Navigasi Kapal",
            kategori: "Sarana & Prasarana",
            status: "Dalam Proses",
            tanggal: "2026-08-15",
            deskripsi: "Pengadaan simulator navigasi kelas A memerlukan sertifikasi kelayakan audit internasional sebelum dapat difungsikan untuk kegiatan perkuliahan semester ganjil.",
            tindakLanjut: [
              { 
                id: "tl-101", 
                tanggal: "2026-08-18", 
                ket: "Penerbitan Surat Teguran Resmi I kepada Penyedia Jasa terkait jadwal audit.", 
                files: [{ name: "Surat_Teguran_PPK_01.pdf", size: "1.2 MB" }] 
              },
              { 
                id: "tl-102", 
                tanggal: "2026-08-25", 
                ket: "Pelaksanaan Rapat Koordinasi Bersama Tim Verifikator Layanan Kelautan.", 
                files: [{ name: "Notulensi_Rakor_Simulator.pdf", size: "840 KB" }] 
              }
            ],
            files: [{ name: "Kontrak_Pengadaan_Simulator.pdf", size: "4.5 MB" }]
          },
          {
            id: "iss-102",
            judul: "Revisi Pagu Anggaran Penyerapan BOPTN Triwulan III",
            kategori: "Keuangan & Anggaran",
            status: "Selesai",
            tanggal: "2026-07-10",
            deskripsi: "Penyelarasan alokasi dana operasional riset terapan kemaritiman dengan KPPN setempat.",
            tindakLanjut: [
              { 
                id: "tl-103", 
                tanggal: "2026-07-15", 
                ket: "Pengajuan revisi Pok dan persetujuan Surat Perintah Membayar (SPM).", 
                files: [{ name: "SPM_BOPTN_Approved.pdf", size: "2.1 MB" }] 
              }
            ],
            files: [{ name: "Laporan_Revisi_BOPTN.pdf", size: "3.0 MB" }]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: "satker-102",
        nama: "Universitas Negeri Jakarta",
        kode: "001002",
        singkatan: "UNJ",
        email: "admin@unj.ac.id",
        sandi: "UNJSatker2026#",
        issues: [
          {
            id: "iss-103",
            judul: "Sinkronisasi Server PDDikti Feeder Wisuda Periode II",
            kategori: "TIK & Sistem Informasi",
            status: "Baru",
            tanggal: "2026-08-28",
            deskripsi: "Ganggual konektivitas database akademik lokal dengan server pusat Dikti pada saat validasi penomoran ijazah nasional (PIN).",
            tindakLanjut: [],
            files: [{ name: "Log_Error_PDDikti.txt", size: "320 KB" }]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: "satker-103",
        nama: "Institut Teknologi Bandung",
        kode: "001001",
        singkatan: "ITB",
        email: "admin@itb.ac.id",
        sandi: "ITBKampus2026$",
        issues: [
          {
            id: "iss-104",
            judul: "Penataan Sertifikasi BMN Lahan Jatinangor",
            kategori: "Barang Milik Negara (BMN)",
            status: "Selesai",
            tanggal: "2026-06-01",
            deskripsi: "Penyelesaian proses legalitas dan pemetakan ulang aset tanah kampus Jatinangor bersama BPN.",
            tindakLanjut: [
              { 
                id: "tl-104", 
                tanggal: "2026-06-20", 
                ket: "Penerbitan Sertifikat Hak Pakai atas nama Kementerian.", 
                files: [{ name: "Sertifikat_BMN_Jatinangor.pdf", size: "5.8 MB" }] 
              }
            ],
            files: [{ name: "Peta_BPN_Jatinangor.pdf", size: "12.4 MB" }]
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: "satker-104",
        nama: "Universitas Gadjah Mada",
        kode: "001003",
        singkatan: "UGM",
        email: "admin@ugm.ac.id",
        sandi: "UGM2026Pass!",
        issues: [
          {
            id: "iss-105",
            judul: "Verifikasi Berkas Rekrutmen Dosen Tetap Non-PNS",
            kategori: "SDM & Kepegawaian",
            status: "Selesai",
            tanggal: "2026-05-12",
            deskripsi: "Pemeriksaan dan validasi portofolio kelayakan penerbitan NIDN dosen baru.",
            tindakLanjut: [
              { 
                id: "tl-105", 
                tanggal: "2026-05-25", 
                ket: "Verifikasi dokumen berhasil dan penetapan NIDN diterbitkan.", 
                files: [{ name: "SK_NIDN_Kolektif.pdf", size: "1.9 MB" }] 
              }
            ],
            files: []
          }
        ]
      }
    ];

    function App() {
      // Local storage persistence
      const [satkers, setSatkers] = useState(() => {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem("diktisaintek_satker_v2");
        return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : DATABASE_SATKER_INITIAL;
      });

      // Session Management
      const [currentUserSatker, setCurrentUserSatker] = useState(null);
      const [loginTargetSatker, setLoginTargetSatker] = useState(null);
      
      // Form Login States
      const [loginEmail, setLoginEmail] = useState("");
      const [loginPassword, setLoginPassword] = useState("");
      const [authError, setAuthError] = useState("");

      // Issue & Detail States
      const [activeIssue, setActiveIssue] = useState(null);
      const [showNewIssueModal, setShowNewIssueModal] = useState(false);

      // Form New Issue States
      const [newJudul, setNewJudul] = useState("");
      const [newKategori, setNewKategori] = useState("Akademik & Kemahasiswaan");
      const [newDeskripsi, setNewDeskripsi] = useState("");
      const [newIssueFiles, setNewIssueFiles] = useState([]);

      // Form Tindak Lanjut States
      const [newTLText, setNewTLText] = useState("");
      const [newTLFiles, setNewTLFiles] = useState([]);

      useEffect(() => {
        localStorage.setItem("diktisaintek_satker_v2", JSON.stringify(satkers));
      }, [satkers]);

      // --- SINKRONISASI USER AKTIF SAAT DATA BERUBAH ---
      const activeSatkerData = useMemo(() => {
        if (!currentUserSatker) return null;
        return satkers.find(s => s.id === currentUserSatker.id) || currentUserSatker;
      }, [satkers, currentUserSatker]);

      // --- STATISTIK KESELURUHAN PORTAL DIKTI ---
      const nationalStats = useMemo(() => {
        let totalSatker = satkers.length;
        let totalIssues = 0;
        let finishedIssues = 0;
        let inProgressIssues = 0;
        let newIssues = 0;
        let fullyResolvedSatkerCount = 0;

        satkers.forEach(satker => {
          const issues = satker.issues || [];
          totalIssues += issues.length;
          
          let satkerDoneCount = 0;
          issues.forEach(issue => {
            if (issue.status === "Selesai") finishedIssues++;
            if (issue.status === "Dalam Proses") inProgressIssues++;
            if (issue.status === "Baru") newIssues++;
            if (issue.status === "Selesai") satkerDoneCount++;
          });

          if (issues.length > 0 && satkerDoneCount === issues.length) {
            fullyResolvedSatkerCount++;
          }
        });

        const pctIssueResolved = totalIssues > 0 ? Math.round((finishedIssues / totalIssues) * 100) : 0;
        const pctSatkerResolved = totalSatker > 0 ? Math.round((fullyResolvedSatkerCount / totalSatker) * 100) : 0;

        return {
          totalSatker,
          fullyResolvedSatkerCount,
          pctSatkerResolved,
          totalIssues,
          finishedIssues,
          inProgressIssues,
          newIssues,
          pctIssueResolved
        };
      }, [satkers]);

      // --- LOGIC AUTHENTICATION ---
      const handleOpenAuthModal = (satker) => {
        setLoginTargetSatker(satker);
        setLoginEmail("");
        setLoginPassword("");
        setAuthError("");
      };

      const handleExecuteLogin = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!loginTargetSatker) return;

        // Validasi kredensial per Satker
        if (
          loginEmail.trim().toLowerCase() === loginTargetSatker.email.toLowerCase() &&
          loginPassword === loginTargetSatker.sandi
        ) {
          setCurrentUserSatker(loginTargetSatker);
          setLoginTargetSatker(null);
          setAuthError("");
        } else {
          setAuthError("Akses ditolak. Email atau kata sandi tidak sesuai dengan data Satker yang dipilih.");
        }
      };

      const handleLogout = () => {
        setCurrentUserSatker(null);
        setActiveIssue(null);
      };

      // --- FILE HANDLING SIMULATION ---
      const handleFileSelection = (e, setFileState) => {
        const selectedFiles = Array.from(e.target.files);
        selectedFiles.forEach(file => {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onload = () => {
            const mappedFile = {
              name: file.name,
              size: (file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + " MB",
              type: file.type || "application/octet-stream",
              dataUrl: reader.result
            };
            setFileState(prev => [...prev, mappedFile]);
          };
          reader.readAsDataURL(file);
        });
        e.target.value = "";
      };

      // --- CREATE NEW PERMASALAHAN ---
      const handleCreateIssue = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!newJudul || !newDeskripsi || !activeSatkerData) return;

        const createdIssue = {
          id: "iss-" + Date.now(),
          judul: newJudul,
          kategori: newKategori,
          status: "Baru",
          tanggal: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          deskripsi: newDeskripsi,
          tindakLanjut: [],
          files: newIssueFiles
        };

        const updatedSatkers = satkers.map(s => {
          if (s.id === activeSatkerData.id) {
            return { ...s, issues: [createdIssue, ...s.issues] };
          }
          return s;
        });

        setSatkers(updatedSatkers);
        setNewJudul("");
        setNewDeskripsi("");
        setNewIssueFiles([]);
        setShowNewIssueModal(false);
      };

      // --- ADD TINDAK LANJUT ---
      const handleAddTindakLanjut = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!newTLText.trim() || !activeIssue || !activeSatkerData) return;

        const newTLItem = {
          id: "tl-" + Date.now(),
          tanggal: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          ket: newTLText,
          files: newTLFiles
        };

        const updatedIssues = activeSatkerData.issues.map(iss => {
          if (iss.id === activeIssue.id) {
            return {
              ...iss,
              tindakLanjut: [...iss.tindakLanjut, newTLItem],
              status: iss.status === "Baru" ? "Dalam Proses" : iss.status
            };
          }
          return iss;
        });

        const updatedSatkers = satkers.map(s => {
          if (s.id === activeSatkerData.id) {
            return { ...s, issues: updatedIssues };
          }
          return s;
        });

        setSatkers(updatedSatkers);
        const currentUpdatedIssue = updatedIssues.find(i => i.id === activeIssue.id);
        setActiveIssue(currentUpdatedIssue);
        setNewTLText("");
        setNewTLFiles([]);
      };

      // --- UPDATE STATUS ISSUES ---
      const handleUpdateStatus = (issueId, targetStatus) => {
        if (!activeSatkerData) return;

        const updatedIssues = activeSatkerData.issues.map(iss => {
          if (iss.id === issueId) {
            return { ...iss, status: targetStatus };
          }
          return iss;
        });

        const updatedSatkers = satkers.map(s => {
          if (s.id === activeSatkerData.id) {
            return { ...s, issues: updatedIssues };
          }
          return s;
        });

        setSatkers(updatedSatkers);
        if (activeIssue && activeIssue.id === issueId) {
          setActiveIssue(prev => ({ ...prev, status: targetStatus }));
        }
      };

      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-100">
          {/* TOP NAVBAR (PORTAL KEMENDIKBUDRISTEK DIKTI) */}
          <header className="bg-white text-slate-900 border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-40 shadow-sm">
            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 min-h-[76px] py-2 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div
                className="flex items-center gap-4 cursor-pointer select-none"
                onClick={() => { setCurrentUserSatker(null); setActiveIssue(null); }}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo Kementerian" className="institutional-header-logo h-14 sm:h-16 w-auto" />
                  <div className="h-10 w-px bg-slate-200 hidden sm:block"></div>
                  <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Diktisaintek Berdampak" className="institutional-header-logo h-14 sm:h-[68px] w-auto" />
                </div>
                <div className="hidden xl:block border-l border-slate-300 pl-4">
                  <h1 className="font-bold text-[15px] leading-tight text-slate-800">Sistem Monitoring Satker</h1>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-medium mt-0.5">Diktisaintek Berdampak</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {activeSatkerData && (
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-4">
                  <div className="text-right hidden sm:block">
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-orange-400">{activeSatkerData.nama}</p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Terautentikasi: {activeSatkerData.email}</p>
                  </div>
                  <button 
                    onClick={handleLogout}
                    className="text-xs bg-red-600/90 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded border border-red-500 transition shadow-sm"
                  >
                    Keluar Sesi
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </header>

          {/* MAIN CONTAINER */}
          <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
            {!activeSatkerData ? (
              /* ================= LANDING PAGE & DASHBOARD NASIONAL DIKTI ================= */
              <div className="space-y-8">
                {/* HERO BANNER PORTAL */}
                <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-slate-800 to-blue-950 rounded-lg p-6 sm:p-8 text-white shadow-md border border-slate-700 relative overflow-hidden"><div className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1/3 pointer-events-none hidden md:block">
                    <div className="absolute right-10 top-8 w-28 h-28 rounded-full border border-white/10"></div>
                    <div className="absolute right-24 bottom-8 w-20 h-20 rounded-full border border-orange-400/10"></div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="relative z-10">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                      <span className="bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-200 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-orange-500/30">
                        PORTAL RESMI
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold mt-3 tracking-tight leading-[1.12] max-w-3xl">
                      Monitoring dan Tindak Lanjut Permasalahan Satker
                    </h2>
                    <p className="text-slate-300 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-2 max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">
                      Satu pintu untuk melaporkan, memantau, dan menindaklanjuti permasalahan satuan kerja perguruan tinggi.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* STATISTIK RANANGKUMAN KESELURUHAN (DIKTI) */}
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-orange-500"></span>
                      Ringkasan Status
                    </h3>
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">Data Terkini</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
                    {/* STAT CARD 1: % Satker Bebas Masalah */}
                    <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm relative">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Satker Terselesaikan</p>
                      <div className="flex items-baseline space-x-2 mt-2">
                        <span className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900">{nationalStats.pctSatkerResolved}%</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">dari seluruh satker</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-2">
                        <strong className="text-blue-700">{nationalStats.fullyResolvedSatkerCount}</strong> dari {nationalStats.totalSatker} satker telah menyelesaikan seluruh laporannya.
                      </p>
                      <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 h-2 rounded-full mt-4 overflow-hidden">
                        <div 
                          className="bg-blue-700 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-700"
                          style={{ width: `${nationalStats.pctSatkerResolved}%` }}
                        ></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* STAT CARD 2: % Masalah Selesai */}
                    <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Penyelesaian Laporan</p>
                      <div className="flex items-baseline space-x-2 mt-2">
                        <span className="text-3xl font-black text-emerald-600">{nationalStats.pctIssueResolved}%</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">laporan selesai</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-2">
                        <strong className="text-emerald-600">{nationalStats.finishedIssues}</strong> dari {nationalStats.totalIssues} laporan telah selesai.
                      </p>
                      <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 h-2 rounded-full mt-4 overflow-hidden">
                        <div 
                          className="bg-emerald-500 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-700"
                          style={{ width: `${nationalStats.pctIssueResolved}%` }}
                        ></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* STAT CARD 3: Distribution Breakdown */}
                    <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Perlu Tindak Lanjut</p>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 my-2">
                        <div className="bg-orange-50 border border-orange-200 p-2.5 rounded-lg">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-orange-700 uppercase">Dalam Proses</span>
                          <p className="text-xl font-extrabold text-orange-900">{nationalStats.inProgressIssues}</p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 p-2.5 rounded-lg">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase">Masalah Baru</span>
                          <p className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-800">{nationalStats.newIssues}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic">Laporan yang masih membutuhkan tindak lanjut.</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* DAFTAR SATKER DIKTI */}
                <div>
                  <div className="mb-4">
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 tracking-tight">Satuan Kerja</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Pilih satker untuk melihat laporan dan tindak lanjut.</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    {satkers.map((satker) => {
                      const totalI = satker.issues.length;
                      const doneI = satker.issues.filter(i => i.status === "Selesai").length;
                      const ratio = totalI > 0 ? Math.round((doneI / totalI) * 100) : 100;

                      return (
                        <div 
                          key={satker.id}
                          onClick={() => handleOpenAuthModal(satker)}
                          className="bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-400 p-5 shadow-sm hover:shadow transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between group"
                        >
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200">
                                Kode: {satker.kode}
                              </span>
                              <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                                ratio === 100 ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800' : 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800'
                              }`}>
                                {ratio}% Teratasi
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <h4 className="text-[17px] font-bold text-slate-900 mt-3 group-hover:text-blue-700 transition leading-snug">
                              {satker.nama}
                            </h4>
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                              Terdaftar {totalI} laporan permasalahan ({doneI} terselesaikan).
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                            <span className="text-slate-400 font-medium">Akses Terproteksi</span>
                            <span className="text-blue-700 font-bold group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform flex items-center gap-1">
                              Buka Portal &rarr;
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              /* ================= PAGE SATKER: MANAJEMEN KENDALA & TINDAK LANJUT ================= */
              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* SUB HEADER */}
                <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <button 
                      onClick={() => { setCurrentUserSatker(null); setActiveIssue(null); }}
                      className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 hover:underline mb-1 inline-block"
                    >
                      &larr; Kembali ke Satuan Kerja
                    </button>
                    <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900">{activeSatkerData.nama}</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                      Kode Satker: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">{activeSatkerData.kode}</span> &bull; Akun: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700">{activeSatkerData.email}</span>
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <button 
                    onClick={() => setShowNewIssueModal(true)}
                    className="bg-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg transition shadow"
                  >
                    + Buat Laporan Masalah Baru
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* TABEL PERMASALAHAN SATKER */}
                <div className="bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
                  <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 flex justify-between items-center">
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">
                      Daftar Laporan Permasalahan
                    </h3>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Pilih laporan untuk melihat detail dan tindak lanjut</span>
                  </div>

                  {activeSatkerData.issues.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 text-xs">
                      Belum ada laporan permasalahan.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                      <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                        <thead className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 uppercase font-bold border-b border-slate-200">
                          <tr>
                            <th className="py-3 px-4">Permasalahan</th>
                            <th className="py-3 px-4">Kategori</th>
                            <th className="py-3 px-4">Tanggal</th>
                            <th className="py-3 px-4">Status</th>
                            <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Tindak Lanjut</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                          {activeSatkerData.issues.map((issue) => {
                            const isSelected = activeIssue && activeIssue.id === issue.id;
                            let statusStyle = "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700";
                            if (issue.status === "Dalam Proses") statusStyle = "bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border border-orange-200";
                            if (issue.status === "Selesai") statusStyle = "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200";
                            if (issue.status === "Baru") statusStyle = "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200";

                            return (
                              <tr 
                                key={issue.id}
                                onClick={() => setActiveIssue(issue)}
                                className={`cursor-pointer transition hover:bg-slate-50 ${isSelected ? 'bg-blue-50/70 font-medium' : ''}`}
                              >
                                <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                                  <p className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">{issue.judul}</p>
                                  <p className="text-slate-500 line-clamp-1 mt-0.5">{issue.deskripsi}</p>
                                </td>
                                <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                  <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-200">
                                    {issue.kategori}
                                  </span>
                                </td>
                                <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-slate-500 whitespace-nowrap">{issue.tanggal}</td>
                                <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                                  <span className={`font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] ${statusStyle}`}>
                                    {issue.status}
                                  </span>
                                </td>
                                <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                                  <span className="bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                                    {issue.tindakLanjut.length} Catatan
                                  </span>
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            );
                          })}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* DETAIL WORKFLOW & TINDAK LANJUT SEBAGAI PROPER FITUR MANDIRI */}
                {activeIssue && (
                  <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-lg border border-blue-200 shadow-md space-y-6">
                    <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 pb-4 gap-4">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-100">
                          Detail Laporan
                        </span>
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 mt-1">{activeIssue.judul}</h3>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">ID Referensi: {activeIssue.id} &bull; Dilaporkan: {activeIssue.tanggal}</p>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">Update Status:</label>
                        <select 
                          value={activeIssue.status}
                          onChange={(e) => handleUpdateStatus(activeIssue.id, e.target.value)}
                          className="text-xs font-bold border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                        >
                          <option value="Baru">Baru</option>
                          <option value="Dalam Proses">Dalam Proses</option>
                          <option value="Selesai">Selesai</option>
                        </select>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Deskripsi & Dokumen Masalah Utama */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                      <div className="md:col-span-2 bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                        <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-500 mb-1">Deskripsi</h4>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-800 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">{activeIssue.deskripsi}</p>
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                        <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-500 mb-2">Dokumen</h4>
                        {activeIssue.files && activeIssue.files.length > 0 ? (
                          <div className="space-y-1.5">
                            {activeIssue.files.map((file, idx) => (
                              <div key={idx} className="bg-white p-2 rounded border border-slate-200 text-xs flex justify-between items-center">
                                <a href={file.dataUrl || "#"} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                   onClick={(e) => { if (!file.dataUrl) e.preventDefault(); }}
                                   className="font-medium text-blue-700 truncate mr-2 hover:underline">📄 {file.name}</a>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{file.size}</span>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic">Tidak ada dokumen.</p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* RIWAYAT & INPUT TINDAK LANJUT MANDIRI */}
                    <div className="border-t border-slate-200 pt-4">
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span>Tindak Lanjut dan Bukti Penyelesaian</span>
                        <span className="text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
                          {activeIssue.tindakLanjut.length}
                        </span>
                      </h4>

                      {/* List Tindak Lanjut */}
                      <div className="space-y-3 mb-6">
                        {activeIssue.tindakLanjut.length === 0 ? (
                          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 text-center rounded-lg border border-dashed border-slate-300 text-xs text-slate-400">
                            Belum ada tindak lanjut.
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          activeIssue.tindakLanjut.map((tl) => (
                            <div key={tl.id} className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 space-y-2">
                              <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                                <span className="font-bold text-blue-900">Tindak Lanjut Satker</span>
                                <span className="text-slate-400 font-medium">{tl.tanggal}</span>
                              </div>
                              <p className="text-xs text-slate-800 font-medium">{tl.ket}</p>

                              {/* Dokumen Lampiran Tindak Lanjut */}
                              {tl.files && tl.files.length > 0 && (
                                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/60 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                  {tl.files.map((f, i) => (
                                    <a key={i} href={f.dataUrl || "#"} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                   onClick={(e) => { if (!f.dataUrl) e.preventDefault(); }}
                                   className="bg-white text-slate-700 text-[11px] font-semibold px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm hover:border-blue-400 hover:text-blue-700">
                                      📎 {f.name} <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400">({f.size})</span>
                                    </a>
                                  ))}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          ))
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* FORM TAMBAH TINDAK LANJUT BERIKUT UPLOAD FILE MANDIRI */}
                      <form onSubmit={handleAddTindakLanjut} className="bg-blue-50/50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-blue-100 space-y-3">
                        <h5 className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-950 uppercase">Tambah Tindak Lanjut dan Dokumen</h5>
                        
                        <textarea 
                          rows={3}
                          required
                          placeholder="Tuliskan tindakan yang sudah dilakukan..."
                          value={newTLText}
                          onChange={(e) => setNewTLText(e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full text-xs border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                        ></textarea>

                        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                          {/* File Upload Button */}
                          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                            <label className="cursor-pointer bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 text-xs font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-lg transition shadow-sm inline-block">
                              📁 Tambah Dokumen
                              <input 
                                type="file" 
                                multiple
                                onChange={(e) => handleFileSelection(e, setNewTLFiles)}
                                className="hidden" 
                              />
                            </label>
                            <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                              {newTLFiles.length} file terpilih
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <button 
                            type="submit"
                            className="bg-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-bold px-5 py-2 rounded-lg transition shadow"
                          >
                            Simpan Tindak Lanjut
                          </button>
                        </div>

                        {/* List Preview Uploaded Files */}
                        {newTLFiles.length > 0 && (
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-2">
                            {newTLFiles.map((f, idx) => (
                              <a key={idx} href={f.dataUrl || "#"} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                 onClick={(e) => { if (!f.dataUrl) e.preventDefault(); }}
                                 className="bg-white text-xs text-slate-700 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1 hover:border-blue-400 hover:text-blue-700">
                                📄 {f.name} ({f.size})
                              </a>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </form>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </main>

          {/* ================= MODAL LOGIN KREDENSIAL SATKER ================= */}
          {loginTargetSatker && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
                <div className="mb-3 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100 rounded-lg p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-900 mb-1">Kredensial Akses</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      Gunakan <strong>Email</strong> dan <strong>Password</strong> yang terdaftar pada sistem.
                    </p>
                    <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      <div className="bg-white border border-blue-100 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2">
                        <p className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Username / Email</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 break-all">{loginTargetSatker?.email || "-"}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-white border border-blue-100 rounded-md px-2.5 py-2">
                        <p className="text-[9px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400">Password</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700">{loginTargetSatker?.sandi || "-"}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-700">Login Satker</span>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 mt-0.5">Masuk Satker</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                    Masukkan akun Satker untuk melanjutkan. <strong className="text-slate-800">{loginTargetSatker.nama}</strong>.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {authError && (
                  <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-600 text-xs p-3 rounded-lg border border-red-200 font-medium">
                    {authError}
                  </div>
                )}

                <form onSubmit={handleExecuteLogin} className="space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Email</label>
                    <input 
                      type="email" 
                      required
                      placeholder="nama@satker.ac.id"
                      value={loginEmail}
                      onChange={(e) => setLoginEmail(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full text-xs border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Password</label>
                    <input 
                      type="password" 
                      required
                      placeholder="••••••••••••"
                      value={loginPassword}
                      onChange={(e) => setLoginPassword(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full text-xs border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2.5 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
                    <button 
                      type="button" 
                      onClick={() => setLoginTargetSatker(null)}
                      className="w-1/2 text-xs border border-slate-300 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 font-bold"
                    >
                      Batal
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      type="submit" 
                      className="w-1/2 text-xs bg-blue-700 text-white py-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 font-bold transition shadow"
                    >
                      Masuk
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ================= MODAL BUAT LAPORAN MASALAH BARU ================= */}
          {showNewIssueModal && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4">
                <div className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900">Laporan Permasalahan Baru</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Isi laporan berikut untuk menyampaikan permasalahan yang perlu ditindaklanjuti.</p>
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={handleCreateIssue} className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Judul Permasalahan</label>
                    <input 
                      type="text" 
                      required
                      placeholder="Contoh: Keterlambatan sertifikasi peralatan"
                      value={newJudul}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewJudul(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2.5 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Kategori</label>
                    <select 
                      value={newKategori}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewKategori(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2.5 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 bg-white font-medium"
                    >
                      <option value="Akademik & Kemahasiswaan">Akademik & Kemahasiswaan</option>
                      <option value="Sarana & Prasarana">Sarana & Prasarana</option>
                      <option value="Barang Milik Negara (BMN)">Barang Milik Negara (BMN)</option>
                      <option value="Keuangan & Anggaran">Keuangan & Anggaran</option>
                      <option value="SDM & Kepegawaian">SDM & Kepegawaian</option>
                      <option value="TIK & Sistem Informasi">TIK & Sistem Informasi</option>
                      <option value="Lainnya">Lainnya</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Rincian Permasalahan</label>
                    <textarea 
                      required
                      rows={4}
                      placeholder="Jelaskan kondisi, kronologi, dan dampak permasalahan..."
                      value={newDeskripsi}
                      onChange={(e) => setNewDeskripsi(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2.5 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600"
                    ></textarea>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 mb-1">Tambah Dokumen</label>
                    <input 
                      type="file" 
                      multiple
                      onChange={(e) => handleFileSelection(e, setNewIssueFiles)}
                      className="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2 bg-slate-50 text-slate-600"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex gap-2 pt-3">
                    <button 
                      type="button" 
                      onClick={() => setShowNewIssueModal(false)}
                      className="w-1/2 border border-slate-300 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 font-bold"
                    >
                      Batal
                    </button>
                    <button 
                      type="submit" 
                      className="w-1/2 bg-blue-700 text-white py-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 font-bold transition shadow"
                    >
                      Simpan Laporan
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </form>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* FOOTER */}
          <footer className="institutional-footer bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 text-xs py-6 border-t-2 border-orange-500">
            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 text-center">
              <p className="font-bold text-slate-100">
                Direktorat Jenderal Pendidikan Tinggi, Riset, dan Teknologi &copy; 2026
              </p>
              <p className="text-slate-300 mt-1">
                Portal Monitoring dan Evaluasi Satuan Kerja Perguruan Tinggi
              </p>
              <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                <p className="font-semibold text-slate-300">
                  Kementerian Pendidikan Tinggi, Sains, dan Teknologi Republik Indonesia
                </p>
                <p className="text-slate-500">
                  Biro Keuangan dan Barang Milik Negara &bull; Sekretariat Jenderal
                </p>
                <p className="text-slate-500">
                  Jalan Jenderal Sudirman, Gedung D, Senayan, Jakarta 10270
                </p>
                <p className="text-slate-500">
                  <a href="https://www.kemdiktisaintek.go.id" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                     className="hover:text-orange-400 transition">
                    www.kemdiktisaintek.go.id
                  </a>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </footer>
        </div>
      );
    }

    const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root"));
    root.render(<App />);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
